## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Distinguish observed hardware
behavior, static recovery and design decisions.

## Validation

List the relevant offline checks and results. Hardware tests require a separate,
coordinated local session; CI never operates a NUC or installs a service.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe affected boards/protocols, preserved unknown fields and rollback where relevant.
Use a Conventional Commit PR title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `ci:`, etc.).
